channel.title: Pier & Point · Sister Lillian Murphy Community
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Sister Lillian Murphy Community (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Sister Lillian Murphy Community: The map notes gave the parcel as 7,363 sq m and the footprint union as 892 sq m; both are Web Mercator areas, and the true figures are about 4,590 and 556 sq m, so a dated correction was added. The summary no longer says Sister Lillian Murphy founded Mercy Housing or belonged to the Sisters of Mercy (SF YIMBY says she led Mercy Housing for 27 years), names the developer as Mercy Housing as the article does, and cites DataSF Parcels for the 671-691 address range. The permit quotation is now verbatim, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight.
